sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: *Nem* says that an action does not happen: *Anna nem olvas.* *Nincs* says that someone or something is not there: *Anna nincs itt.* *Nincs* is *nem* and *van* in one word, so it replaces *van*. You do not write both.

sections.title: I and you
sections.content: *Nincs* is for “he, she, it” and for names. For “I” and “you” the verbs are *vagyok* and *vagy*, and *nem* stays a separate word: *Nem vagyok otthon.* and *Nem vagy itt.*

items.english: Meg is not in the kitchen.

sections.content: Say *Anna nincs itt*, not *Anna nem van itt*. And never *Anna nincs ír*: *ír* is an action, so it takes *nem*.
